sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The FlashInfer project published v0.6.17 on 2026-08-11 UTC.

The release notes describe MoE expert parallelism for serving engines, refreshed Blackwell SM12x fused-MoE kernels with an FP4 accuracy fix, MXFP4 W4A8/W4A16/shared-expert support, and Kimi K3 MLA plus MiniMax-M3 sparse-attention decode coverage under vLLM.

limitations.text: The release-note characterization of production readiness, fault tolerance, kernel accuracy, and performance is a project claim; this Evidence pass does not independently benchmark it.

targets.target: Verify chronology, primary-source identity, technical claims, and overlap before selection.
targets.finding: The project release page establishes the W33 date and the listed kernel/MoE integration changes. Its overlap with vLLM and SGLang is intentional and should be consolidated editorially.

unresolved_questions: Which release-note changes are material enough to survive cross-candidate comparison?

editorial.why_now_note: FlashInfer v0.6.17 was published in W33 with material MoE-serving and decode-kernel integration changes that connect directly to the vLLM/SGLang serving stack.
editorial.rationale: Candidate for an inference-stack package rather than necessarily a standalone article.
